title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.27889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies in harness optimization have shown substantial performance gains in language model agents without updating model weights. A well-designed harness more effectively leverages the underlying model's capabilities by shaping context, tool use, and execution workflows. However, na\"ive success rates alone do not fully characterize whether optimized harness yields more reliable success on tasks already within reach (elicitation) or a broader range of solvable tasks (expansion). This distinction is crucial for recursive self-improvement and evolutionary search, as expansion may provide a broader range of successful experiences to push the capability boundaries. Despite the growing significance, this distinction remains underexplored in harness optimization. We conduct a systematic analysis to study the effect of gains from harness optimization. translated_title: 激发还是扩展？揭秘智能体框架优化的收益来源
translated_abstract: 近年来，框架（harness）优化的研究表明，在不更新模型权重的情况下，语言模型智能体也能获得显著的性能提升。一个设计良好的框架通过塑造上下文、工具使用和执行工作流，能够更有效地利用底层模型的能力。然而，仅凭朴素的成功率无法充分刻画优化后的框架究竟是在已可完成的任务上取得更可靠的成功（激发，elicitation），还是在更广泛的可解任务上取得成功（扩展，expansion）。这一区分对于递归自我改进和进化搜索至关重要，因为扩展可能提供更广泛的成功经验，从而推动能力边界的拓展。尽管其重要性日益凸显，这一区分在框架优化研究中仍未得到充分探索。我们进行了系统性分析，以研究框架优化带来的收益效果。我们基于强化学习（RL）文献中的pass@k分析（用于比较……）……（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 本文系统性地分析了智能体框架优化带来的性能提升究竟源于“激发”（在已有能力范围内更可靠地完成任务）还是“扩展”（扩大可解任务的范围），并指出这一区分对递归自我改进和进化搜索至关重要。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes whether performance gains from agent harness optimization stem from elicitation (more reliable success on tasks already within reach) or expansion (a broader range of solvable tasks), a distinction crucial for recursive self-improvement and evolutionary search.
